name: Nullform Ghostgrip Infiltration Glove
description:
Featherweight operative gloves in near-black matte polymer-skin, cut close with zero-seam construction at the fingertips. The palm and finger pads are coated in a micro-textured gecko-adhesion compound that clings to glass, brushed metal, and polished concrete without residue. Print-masking is achieved through a continuous electrospun polymer film at the fingertips that conforms to the wearer's ridges without transmitting them.

Thin enough to feel a card-reader's surface contours. The cuff is short and elasticated — fits under sleeves without bulk. No branding visible anywhere on the glove. Sold through unlicensed channels only.
functionality: Gecko-adhesion grip on smooth surfaces. Electrospun fingertip film masks biometric prints. No thermal signature bleed at fingertips. Ultra-low profile under standard sleeves. Leaves no adhesive residue on surfaces.
what_it_says: You go places you aren't supposed to and you don't leave evidence.
story_hooks: A print-masked glove is recovered from a Tier 5 Spire vault breach — the gecko-adhesion pattern on the palm matches a specific Nullform batch traced to a single Circuit district distributor.

Someone is selling Nullform Ghostgrips with a hidden flaw: the print-masking film degrades after 40 minutes of body heat, leaving a perfect impression of the wearer's fingerprints on the last surface touched.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4
